name: Visitor without login cannot access protected profile endpoint
fullName: ../.features-gen/e2e-tests/bdd/features/security-401-unauthorized.feature.spec.js › Authentication Boundary Protection › Visitor without login cannot access protected profile endpoint

steps.name: Given I am not logged in
When I try to access the protected endpoint "/users/me"
Then the response status should be 401
And the response should carry the unauthorized error envelope for "/users/me"
X-Request-ID response header must be set
And the rejection reason should map to messageKey "error.auth.not_authenticated"
expected reason must be an error.auth.* dictionary key
